column1: # Known bugs of upstream versions for IEC 60870-5-103, for scripts/interop.sh.
# Same columns and rules as tests/iec104/known-bugs.tsv. Every entry was seen
# on the wire in a run (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md has the frames); no issue was
# filed upstream, so the URL is the source line at the pinned commit.

column4: Iec103Server answers a general interrogation with cause 11 instead of 9, and its ASDU 1 has DPI, four octets FF and a CP56Time2a (12 octets) instead of DPI, CP32Time2a and SIN (6 octets), so no SIN carries the scan number

Iec103Server confirms a general command with ASDU 1 cause 11 (a refusal with the P/N bit: 139) and the 12-octet elements, never with cause 20 or 21 and the RII as SIN; it identifies with function type 255, for which Open103 sends no command at all

After a reset of the communication unit Iec103Server sends two ASDU 5 (function type 255, INF 80 with cause 4 and INF 81 with cause 5) of eight ASCII characters only: no compatibility level, no software identification, and INF 80 instead of 3

Iec103AsduBuilder.ClockSynchronization sends ASDU 6 with a CP32Time2a and one zero octet (5 octets) instead of a CP56Time2a (7 octets); a station that checks the length ignores it and sends no confirmation
